note: These lanes organize the page. Their order is not a mandatory call path, deployment boundary or hierarchy of authority.

lanes.label: Experience and operator surfaces
lanes.purpose: Commands, inspection, explanations, guided examples and accessible navigation.

lanes.label: Project Intelligence and planning
lanes.purpose: Intent, evidence, review, decisions and exact Mission/DAG revisions.

lanes.label: Composition and capability definitions
lanes.purpose: Worker and Cell definitions, topology, links, registries and resolved configuration.

lanes.label: Cognition and context
lanes.purpose: Selected knowledge, reasoning profiles and optional research mechanisms.

lanes.label: Coordination and runtime
lanes.purpose: One workflow lifecycle owner, sessions, event delivery, resource use and bounded lifecycle changes.

lanes.label: Interoperability and domain extension
lanes.purpose: Provider adapters, domain profiles, product relationships and ecosystem boundaries.

lanes.label: Assurance and improvement
lanes.purpose: Evaluation, observability, experiment candidates, learning and research tooling.

lanes.label: Cross-cutting governance and resilience
lanes.purpose: Identity, policy, current grants, gates, isolation, retention and recovery across every lane.
